snmp-server host FWGLUE Intermapper4 poll community Corp.Info version 2c

  urgent-flag allow
class-map TCP
 match port tcp range 1 65535
!

  class TCP
    set connection random-sequence-number disable
    set connection advanced-options allow-urgent-flag
  class inspection_default
    inspect icmp
    no inspect sunrpc
!

tftp-server FWGLUE Backup-Server /

! ########### CONTEXT START ########### 
!
config terminal
!
vlan 3724
  name NOVA22-FWGLUE
!
interface Port-channel1
 switchport trunk allowed vlan add 3724
!
Interface Port-channel3
 switchport trunk allowed vlan add 3724
!
interface vlan3724
  description NOVA22-FWGLUE
  mtu 9216
  ip address 10.45.54.29 255.255.255.248
  standby ip 10.45.54.30
  standby preempt
  standby priority 105
  standby authentication md5 key-string 0 ewhr324jflewfjosdfjofds
  no shutdown
!
router ospf 2
  network 10.45.54.24 0.0.0.7 area 90
!
!copy running startup
! ########### CONTEXT END ############
